linked_process_id.description: Linked process identifier from upstream workflow (do not modify).

analysis_status.description: Status of the AKTA analysis script.

analysis_timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were assembled for database commit (UTC).

analysis_message.description: Message from the AKTA analysis script summarizing outcome.

summary.description: Key peak metrics extracted from the chromatogram.

n_peaks.description: Number of peaks detected in the UV chromatogram.

retention_times_s.description: List of peak retention times in seconds.

retention_times_min.description: List of peak retention times in minutes.

peak_heights_mau.description: List of peak heights in milli-Absorbance Units (mAU).

data_files.description: Output data file names produced by the analysis script.

analysis_results_json.description: Path to JSON file containing full AKTA analysis results.

akta_timeseries_csv.description: Path to CSV file with processed AKTA time series (time, UV, conductivity).

plots.description: Plot files generated by the analysis script.

raw_analysis.description: Raw analysis_results structure from the AKTA analysis script (metadata, warnings, etc.).
